name: nedCAPTCHA 2
description: Adds CATPCHA protection to surveys. See full documentation here.

authors.name: Günther Rezniczek
authors.institution: St. Elisabethgruppe GmbH - Marien Hospital Herne, Klinikum der Ruhr-Universität Bochum

action-tags.description: Use this action tag on a Text Box-type field (without validation) on the first page of the public survey instrument to set up a CAPTHCA. The field's label will be used as the prompt for the CAPTCHA. Use the setup helper by clicking this action tag on the Online Designer fields view.
When added to a descriptive field, uses the field's label as the survey intro instead of the original survey introduction text when the CAPTCHA is presented.
Apply to a decriptive field on the first survey page. This field will be hidden and only shown when the survey respondent fails the CAPTCHA.
